headline: OpenAI withdrew three of the 722 maths manuscripts it posted on 6 Oct after finding a sign error that broke one argument and two papers built on it.
score_reason: Real and sourced, but the withdrawal happened on 7 Oct; one point below the pool score.
importance_line: Mathematicians checking the release learn that errors are already surfacing, and OpenAI says about half the results were released without full formal confirmation.
summary: Retraction Watch reports that OpenAI withdrew three manuscripts on 7 Oct, a day after posting 722 preprints on 372 maths problems, and revised 14 others with proof repairs and corrections. This follows the release we carried on 7 Oct 2026 from The Verge, and a Cornell mathematician told Retraction Watch he expects more errors to be found.
notes: Read in full. Withdrawal confirmed by OpenAI's announcement and spokesperson.
